about.title: About Me
about.p1: I am a Computer Science student at the Polish-Japanese Academy of Information Technology, focused on backend development, databases and software engineering.
about.p2: My main technology stack includes Java, Spring Boot, SQL, Hibernate/JPA, REST APIs and Git. I enjoy understanding how systems work under the hood, designing database structures, and turning requirements into functional applications.
about.p3: I also have experience working in project management, which helped me develop communication, teamwork, organization, and problem-solving skills alongside my technical background.
experience.title: Experience
experience.p1: Worked with a development team on planning and coordinating project activities, communicating requirements, organizing tasks, and ensuring that work progressed according to project goals.
experience.p2: This experience gave me a broader understanding of the software development lifecycle and how developers, business requirements, and project management interact.

beyond.title: Beyond Coding
beyond.p1: Outside of programming, I am strongly connected with basketball. I enjoy playing and following the sport, and it has taught me discipline, consistency and teamwork.
beyond.p2: I am also interested in technology, gaming, cars and travelling. I prefer learning through practice and building real projects rather than relying only on theory.
